mission.name: Multi-contact near-encirclement
mission.description: Six near-simultaneous collision-course contacts spread around a near-full circle (bow, both bows, both beams, near-astern), each with a scripted, non-COLREG-compliant reversal late in the encounter (give-way vessels turning further into own-ship's track instead of away). No single-contact avoidance plan works -- correct: Rule 8, a holistic plan with due regard to good seamanship, not a per-contact reaction.
pass_criteria: Own-ship avoids collision with all 6 contacts.
